summary.content:
Today's selection covers 112 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 71 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: One company is at the center of a wave of rogue AI attacks
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 61 articles published in the last 24 hours
